seo.title: Privacy Policy | Darb
seo.description: How Darb collects, uses and protects student data during German university applications.

hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.subtitle: What data we collect, why, who we share it with, and how you stay in control.

privacy.intro: This policy explains how Darb handles personal information belonging to students, partners and team members who use the website and dashboards. It applies to the Darb website and every account connected to it.

sections.title: Who is responsible for your data
sections.body: Darb is the party responsible for processing your personal data on this platform. For any privacy question or request, contact us at darbsocial27@gmail.com.

sections.title: Data we collect
sections.body: We collect only what the service requires:
items: Contact and identity data: full name, phone number, email, city, date of birth, nationality.
Academic data: education level, Bagrut average, maths and English units, German level, preferred field of study.
Application file data: passport type, number and expiry, visa status, emergency contact, biometric photo, and address in Germany where relevant.
Documents you upload: certificates, passport, proof of accommodation, health insurance, bank statements and other case attachments.
Case financial data: service fee, payments, invoices and payment status.
Partner and ambassador data: name, email and bank details (IBAN and bank name) used solely to pay commissions.
Limited technical data: sign-in records and referral-link clicks (session identifier, browser type, and a hashed IP address rather than the raw address).

sections.title: Why we process it
items: Assessing your eligibility to study in Germany and preparing your application file.
Applying on your behalf to universities, language schools, accommodation providers and insurers.
Scheduling appointments, tracking your case stages and notifying you of updates.
Issuing invoices, recording payments and calculating partner commissions.
Platform security, abuse prevention, and legal or accounting obligations.

sections.title: Legal basis
sections.body: We rely on your consent when you submit an application, on performance of our agreement once the service begins, on our legitimate interest in keeping the platform secure, and on legal and accounting obligations when retaining payment records.

sections.title: Who we share data with
sections.body: We never sell or rent your data. Sharing happens only in these cases:
items: German universities, language schools, accommodation providers and insurers — only as needed to submit your application.
Darb team members assigned to your case; other staff cannot open cases that are not assigned to them.
Partners and ambassadors see only the cases generated by their own referral links, and never your documents or sensitive data.
The cloud infrastructure provider that hosts our database, files and sign-in system on our behalf.
Authorities, where we are legally required to disclose.

sections.title: How we protect your data
items: Access is enforced at the database level (Row Level Security) per role: student, team member, partner, admin.
Documents live in private storage reachable only by the case owner, the assigned staff member and administrators.
All traffic to the site is encrypted over HTTPS.
There is no open self-signup; accounts are created by staff with a temporary password that must be changed at first sign-in, with leaked-password checking enabled.
Failed sign-ins and unauthorized access attempts are logged so regressions are caught early.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: We keep your case data for as long as we provide the service. After a case closes, invoices and payment records are retained for the period accounting law requires, and the rest is deleted or anonymised on request. Deletions are logged internally so a mistaken deletion can be reversed.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You may at any time request access to your data, correction, deletion of your account and data, withdrawal of consent, or a copy of your file. Email darbsocial27@gmail.com and we will respond within a reasonable time. You can also edit much of your data directly from the student dashboard.

sections.title: Cookies and tracking
sections.body: We use no advertising trackers and no third-party analytics. We use only essential local storage to keep you signed in and remember your language, plus a referral-click record so an application is attributed to the correct partner.

sections.title: Minors
sections.body: The service is intended for people aged 18 and over. If you are younger, a parent or guardian must submit or approve the application.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this policy as our services change. The last-updated date appears at the top of this page, and we will notify users about material changes.

seo.title: Terms of Use | Darb
seo.description: Terms governing Darb's German study application services: scope, fees, student duties and partner rules.

hero.title: Terms of Use
hero.subtitle: The rules that govern your use of the Darb platform and services.

terms.intro: By using the Darb website or submitting an application through it, you agree to the terms below. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.

sections.title: What the service is
sections.body: Darb is a guidance and support platform for students who want to study in Germany: eligibility assessment, file preparation, applications to universities and language schools, accommodation and insurance arrangements, and visa process support.

sections.title: No guarantee of admission or visa
sections.body: Admission and visa decisions are made solely by universities, the German embassy and official authorities. We provide professional preparation and support; we do not guarantee any specific outcome and we are not a legal or governmental body.

sections.title: Accounts
sections.body: Student accounts are created by the Darb team with a temporary password that must be changed at first sign-in. You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for all activity under your account, and must tell us immediately about any unauthorised use.

sections.title: Student obligations
items: Provide accurate, complete and current information and documents.
Attend agreed appointments and notify us in advance if you cannot.
Keep your details updated (passport, address, contact method).
Do not use the platform for unlawful purposes or to impersonate anyone.
sections.body: Misleading information can cause official authorities to reject your application and can end the service without refund.

sections.title: Fees and payment
sections.body: Service fees are shown in Israeli new shekels (₪) and are stated before work on your file begins. Darb fees do not include amounts charged by third parties such as universities, language schools, insurers, the embassy, or document translation and certification. Invoices are issued inside the platform and show what has been paid and what remains.

sections.title: Cancellation and refunds
sections.body: Some service items are refundable and some are not; this is defined per service when agreed and appears on the invoice. Amounts already paid to third parties cannot be refunded by us. To cancel, contact us in writing by email.

sections.title: Partners and ambassadors
sections.body: Partners and ambassadors receive personal referral links and a flat commission in shekels set by the administration. Commission is earned only on cases genuinely attributed to the partner's link that complete payment. Misleading marketing or registering a student without their knowledge voids the commission and closes the account.

sections.title: Content and ownership
sections.body: All site content and tools (Bagrut calculator, cost calculator, CV builder and others) belong to Darb and are for personal use. They may not be copied or republished commercially without written permission. Documents you upload remain yours; you grant us permission to use them solely to process your application.

sections.title: Accuracy of information
sections.body: Information published about universities, costs and visa requirements is indicative and can be changed by official bodies. We keep it updated and source it from official references, but you should always verify with the official body before making a decision.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
sections.body: We are not liable for decisions made by official authorities, for delay or harm caused by inaccurate information supplied by the student, or for temporary service interruptions caused by technical issues outside our control.

sections.title: Ending the service
sections.body: Either party may end the engagement in writing. We may suspend an account immediately in cases of fraud, forged information or platform abuse.

sections.title: Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the law applicable at Darb's place of business. Disputes will be resolved amicably wherever possible before any formal proceedings.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For any question about these terms: darbsocial27@gmail.com

seo.title: Accessibility Statement | Darb
seo.description: Darb's accessibility statement under Israeli Standard 5568 and WCAG 2.1 level AA.

hero.title: Accessibility Statement
hero.subtitle: Our commitment to making the site usable by everyone, including people with disabilities.

accessibility.intro: Darb Study International is committed to making its website and dashboards usable by as many people as possible, including people with disabilities, in the spirit of the Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities Law (1998) and the accessibility service regulations issued under it.

sections.title: Standard applied
sections.body: We work to conform to Israeli Standard 5568, which is based on the WCAG 2.1 guidelines at level AA.

sections.title: Accessibility measures taken
items: Semantic HTML with a logical heading hierarchy and page landmarks (main / nav / footer).
Full keyboard operability with a visible focus indicator on every interactive element.
Accessible names (aria-label) for icon-only buttons and links, and alt text for images.
Text colour contrast of at least 4.5:1 in both light and dark mode.
Page zoom up to 200% without loss of content or functionality.
Form validation and error messages announced to screen readers via aria-live regions.
Full right-to-left (RTL) support for Arabic and Hebrew.
Dialogs built on Radix primitives with correct focus trapping and focus return to the trigger.
Responsive design with touch targets of at least 44x44 pixels on mobile.

sections.title: Known limitations
sections.body: Despite our efforts, some areas are not yet fully accessible:
items: PDFs and documents uploaded by students or issued by third parties may not be fully accessible.
Video and embedded third-party content (YouTube, Instagram, maps) depends on the accessibility of those platforms.
Some complex financial tables in the admin dashboard are still difficult to use with a screen reader; improvements are in progress.
The AI assistant may produce long passages of text that are not broken up with headings.

sections.title: Alternative access route
sections.body: If you have difficulty using any part of the site, we can provide the same service through an alternative channel: by phone, by email, or in person at our office, including completing the application form on your behalf with your consent.

sections.title: Accessibility coordinator and reporting channel
sections.body: To report an accessibility problem or request assistance, email darbsocial27@gmail.com. Please describe the page, the problem, and the assistive technology you use. We aim to respond within 14 business days.
